requirements.text: Students should have the ability to personalize their timetables.
Students should be able to color-code their modules in their timetable.
Students should be able to hide canceled classes from their timetable.
Students should be able to add personal study blocks to their timetable.
The system must allow syncing of personalized timetables with external calendar apps like Google Calendar or Outlook.
Students should receive automatic notifications when new grades are posted, ideally within five minutes.
Students should receive reminders for assignment deadlines 48 hours in advance.
Students should receive exam reminders one week before the exam date.
Students should have options for notification methods such as email, SMS, or in-app alerts.
Students should be able to configure the frequency of notifications according to their preferences.
The feedback submission form must be straightforward and user-friendly.
The feedback form should cover essential aspects such as content quality, teaching delivery, and resources provided.
The feedback system must include a rating scale from 1 to 5 along with space for open-ended comments.
Feedback must be collected anonymously to ensure students feel safe expressing their opinions.
Feedback should only be made available to module coordinators after the grade submission deadline.
Academic administrators should have access to aggregated reports on feedback trends across departments and semesters.
All enhancements must fit within the existing portal without requiring new accounts or additional software installations.
The system must comply with GDPR and data retention policies.
